title: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
description: Repair, maintain, or install computers, word processing systems, automated teller machines, and electronic office machines, such as duplicating and fax machines.

projection.title: Computer, automated teller, and office machine repairers

tasks.text: Travel to customers' stores or offices to service machines or to provide emergency repair service.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Reassemble machines after making repairs or replacing parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Advise customers concerning equipment operation, maintenance, or programming.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer product training is relational and situational

dwas.name: Train customers in the use of products.

tasks.text: Maintain parts inventories and order any additional parts needed for repairs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Converse with customers to determine details of equipment problems.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Disassemble machines to examine parts, such as wires, gears, or bearings for wear or defects, using hand or power tools and measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly for inspection is manual work

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment to inspect for deficiencies.

tasks.text: Maintain records of equipment maintenance work or repairs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Repair, adjust, or replace electrical or mechanical components or parts, using hand tools, power tools, or soldering or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Operate machines to test functioning of parts or mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Assemble machines according to specifications, using hand or power tools and measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Install and configure new equipment, including operating software or peripheral equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Program installation on equipment needs physical access

dwas.name: Install programs onto computer or computer-controlled equipment.

tasks.text: Analyze equipment performance records to assess equipment functioning.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Performance data analysis; equipment context human

dwas.name: Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Reinstall software programs or adjust settings on existing software to fix machine malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Program installation on equipment needs physical access

dwas.name: Install programs onto computer or computer-controlled equipment.

tasks.text: Update existing equipment, performing tasks such as installing updated circuit boards or additional memory.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Test new systems to ensure that they are in working order.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical system testing with hands-on instrumentation

dwas.name: Test mechanical systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Test components or circuits of faulty equipment to locate defects, using oscilloscopes, signal generators, ammeters, voltmeters, or special diagnostic software programs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Clean, oil, or adjust mechanical parts to maintain machines' operating efficiency and to prevent breakdowns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Complete repair bills, shop records, time cards, or expense reports.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.

tasks.text: Read specifications, such as blueprints, charts, or schematics, to determine machine settings or adjustments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Align, adjust, or calibrate equipment according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration to specifications

dwas.name: Calibrate equipment to specifications.
Align equipment or machinery.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

dwas.name: Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Lay cable and hook up electrical connections between machines, power sources, and phone lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.
Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Train new repairers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train others in operational procedures.

tasks.text: Enter information into computers to copy programs from one electronic component to another or to draw, modify, or store schematics.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Code entry is routine data input

dwas.name: Enter codes or other information into computers.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration to specifications

dwas.name: Calibrate equipment to specifications.
